description: This is a test class for the EmailSubscriptionDao within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It sets up test fixtures, verifies retrieval of email subscriptions, and tests editing and saving a subscription.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmailSubscriptionDao, testing retrieval and update functionality for email subscription entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the DAO and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO retrieves the expected number of email subscriptions and that the items are of the correct type.

methods.name: testEditEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Tests updating an email subscription's enabled state and saving it back to the database.
